title: The symmetric algebra of a finite projective module is smooth
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $M$ a finite projective $A$-module (a direct summand of a finite free $A$-module), and $\operatorname{Sym}_A(M)$ its symmetric algebra [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. Then the structure map $A\to\operatorname{Sym}_A(M)$ is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M6 (lemma-symmetric-algebra-smooth, line 2112), the implication 'M finite projective => Sym_A(M) smooth' (second paragraph of its proof, using Lemma Tag 07EV lemma-cotangent-complex-symmetric-algebra)
